statements.t: To address this, management is implementing new recruiting and retention programs intended to expand and stabilize our skilled workforce.
The Company expects to deliver substantially all remaining units under these agreements by the end of the first quarter of 2027, which will complete its deliveries under these agreements.

Workforce housing is receiving significant attention across our market areas and given the number of projects currently underway or planned in those areas, we believe there is a meaningful opportunity for additional orders of this type.

These solutions are structured to give us an attractive return on investment when coupled with the gross margin we expect to make on products specifically targeted for sale to these new manufactured housing communities.
The Company’s largest development, in Bastrop County, Texas, is expected to begin lot and home sales in 2027.
The Section 45L new energy efficient home credit does not apply to homes sold after June 30, 2026, which is expected to increase the Company's effective tax rate in future periods.

The Company intends to renew the Revolver before maturity and, given its strong positive operating cash flow, significant cash and equivalents, and absence of outstanding borrowings, does not currently expect to seek an increase in commitment.
The Company accounts for the options as a right of return and records a refund liability for expected exercises, with an offsetting asset for its right to recover the units.

estimates.t: Critical accounting estimates are those that we believe are both significant and require us to make difficult, subjective, or complex judgments, often because we need to estimate the effect of inherently uncertain matters.

estimates.name: Allowance for Loan Losses on Consumer, MHP, Dealer, and Other Notes Receivable — ​
estimates.t: The allowance for loan losses on our consumer loan, manufactured housing community (MHP) note, dealer financed receivable, and other note receivable portfolios reflects management's estimate of losses inherent in those portfolios as of the balance sheet date.

estimates.name: Refund Liability for Workforce Housing Repurchase Options — ​
estimates.t: Estimating the liability requires significant judgment, principally the probability of exercise in each window; the expected fair value of the units at the exercise dates; and the discount rate.
